title: Bianculli v City of New York - Senior Care Co-Pay Settlement
court: Supreme Court of the State of New York, County of New York
eligibility_scope: Medicare-eligible retired NYC employees and eligible dependents enrolled in the specified GHI Senior Care medical plan during January 1, 2022 through January 31, 2023. Reimbursement additionally depends on the customized claim and eligible paid co-pays; NYC employment affiliation is not a universal current-residence restriction.
proof_requirement: Tiered and conditional. Proof of payment supports up-to-full reimbursement; affirmation without payment documents may support limited reimbursement. Name-change or representative-authority proof is required when applicable.
summary: The notice distinguishes class membership from reimbursement eligibility and requires an approved, timely claim. The $53 million fund is not a per-person benefit.
